instruction.text: The height of the tallest dog in history is 3 feet and 8 inches. Use this conversion table to calculate the height of the tallest dog, in centimetres.
My mother is 5 feet and 6 inches tall. Use this conversion table to calculate the height of my mother, in metres.
I bought 10 kilograms of bananas at the market. Use this conversion table to calculate the weight of my bananas, in pounds.
The milkman delivered 12 litres of milk this morning. Use this conversion table to calculate the volume of milk, in pints.
This weekend we are going to run 5 miles. Use this conversion table to calculate the distance, in kilometres.
In some sports the 40 yard dash is used to measure a player’s speed. Use this conversion table to calculate the distance of the dash, in metres.
Martha bought 10 ounces of sugar from the corner shop. Use this conversion table to calculate the weight of the sugar, in grams.
Max puts 560 grams of butter and 5 kilograms of flour in his mixing bowl. Use this conversion table to calculate the total weight of the items in Max’s mixing bowl, in pounds and ounces.
